exact_project_or_supplier_declaration_in.name: TauCeti.IsAspherical
exact_project_or_supplier_declaration_in.statement: def IsAspherical (X : Type u) [TopologicalSpace X] (x : X) : Prop := PathConnectedSpace X ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, Subsingleton (π_ (n + 2) X x)

exact_project_or_supplier_declaration_in.name: TauCeti.IsEilenbergMacLaneSpaceOne
exact_project_or_supplier_declaration_in.statement: def IsEilenbergMacLaneSpaceOne (G : Type u) [Group G] (X : Type v) [TopologicalSpace X] (x : X) : Prop := IsAspherical X x ∧ Nonempty (FundamentalGroup X x ≃* G)

exact_project_or_supplier_declaration_in.hypotheses_note: No extra connectivity, local compactness, Hausdorff, local path connectedness, simple connectedness, or finiteness hypothesis. Source asphericity h already packages PathConnectedSpace E.
exact_project_or_supplier_declaration_in.name: IsCoveringMap.isAspherical
exact_project_or_supplier_declaration_in.statement: theorem IsCoveringMap.isAspherical {E X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace E] [TopologicalSpace X] {p : E → X} {e : E} {x : X} (hp : IsCoveringMap p) (hp_surj : Function.Surjective p) (he : p e = x) (h : TauCeti.IsAspherical E e) : TauCeti.IsAspherical X x

exact_project_or_supplier_declaration_in.hypotheses_note: Already in the required unchanged closure; does not assume simply connected total space.
exact_project_or_supplier_declaration_in.name: IsCoveringMap.mapOfEq_injective
exact_project_or_supplier_declaration_in.statement: theorem IsCoveringMap.mapOfEq_injective {E X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace E] [TopologicalSpace X] {p : E → X} {e : E} {x : X} (hp : IsCoveringMap p) (he : p e = x) : Function.Injective (FundamentalGroup.mapOfEq ⟨p, hp.continuous⟩ he)
